claims.claim_text: 重用比重新 prefill 省 9 到 50 倍算力——3,774 token 文件服務給 8,000 萬 agent，re-prefill 約 150 萬美元，重用約 3 萬美元，token 級一致。
claims.evidence: reuse is 9-50x cheaper in compute than prefill; serving one hot 3774-token document to 80M agents costs ~$1.5M to re-prefill but only ~$0.03M of reuse compute (49.7x less); token-exact (24/24 greedy tokens), no accuracy cost.

claims.claim_text: DeepSeek 逾 15 萬次交換、Moonshot AI 約 340 萬次、MiniMax 約 1,300 萬次且在進行中就被攔下。
claims.evidence: DeepSeek: Over 150,000 exchanges; Moonshot AI: Over 3.4 million; MiniMax: Over 13 million, detected while still active. Detection via chain-of-thought elicitation detection + coordinated-account tooling.

claims.claim_text: Apple 把 CoreText TrueType bytecode hinting 直譯器從 C 改寫成 Swift；安全攻擊面且延遲敏感的熱路徑。
claims.evidence: rewrote its hinting interpreter from C to memory-safe Swift for the Fall 2025 releases; security-critical attack surface; required equivalent performance; runs 13% faster than the C interpreter (lede if anything understates).

claims.claim_text: OVMF 網路堆疊靠 [Depex] 宣告需要亂數裝置，少了它靜默失敗；OVMF 強制 OpenSSL security level 3，拒絕 2048-bit RSA 憑證。
claims.evidence: network stack requires an RNG device, dependency declared in [Depex] of DxeNetLib.inf; EDK II upgrades to security level 3 by default (TlsInit.c SSL_set_security_level), rejecting weak EE cert keys; most distros default to level 2.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare 把 Security Insights 掃描吞吐量拉高十倍、每秒 120 多次，靠重整 Kafka consumer、DB query、API，不加機器。
claims.evidence: sustains over 120 scans per second during peak scheduling, exceeding our 10x improvement goal; scaled throughput 10x without adding hardware.

claims.claim_text: Cloudflare Application Services for Private Origins：公開主機名路由到私有 IP 後端，走既有 IPsec/GRE/mesh 隧道，origin 不必有公開位址。
claims.evidence: launching Application Services for Private Origins; route traffic to private origins without exposing them to the public Internet; across existing IPsec, GRE, Cloudflare Tunnel, CNI, or Cloudflare Mesh.

claims.claim_text: WASI 0.3 正式發布，把原生 async 帶進 component model，元件非阻塞組合。
claims.evidence: WASI 0.3 is official, and async is now native to WebAssembly Components; the WASI Subgroup voted to ratify WASI 0.3.0; host now manages the one event loop shared by all components.

claims.claim_text: npx 不釘版本時，npm 挑符合 Node engines 的版本，沒 engine 限制的舊版成「萬用」預設，可能裝進六年前的程式碼。
claims.evidence: npx without a version resolves the latest compatible with your current Node runtime; an old version with no engine constraints is considered compatible with everything; runtime environments are invisible to agents.

claims.claim_text: Postgres 19 把時態表做進核心：WITHOUT OVERLAPS、FOR PORTION OF、PERIOD 外鍵；只做 application-time，不含 system-time。
claims.evidence: Postgres 19 is finally bringing native temporal table support; PRIMARY KEY (product_id, valid_at WITHOUT OVERLAPS); UPDATE ... FOR PORTION OF valid_at; FOREIGN KEY (product_id, PERIOD valid_at); accommodates application-time half; system time not natively supported.

claims.claim_text: Dropbox 把 MCP 與 Dash 接進設計到程式碼流程，讓工具讀懂設計意圖與程式上下文，改動進 production 前攔下安全回歸。
claims.evidence: MCP lets the agent access the information it needs; Dash has an MCP server exposing its indexed content to other AI tools; the foundational model identifies potential gaps between documented requirements and implementation.
